svg.title: Node Wire layers
svg.desc: Deployment input config/connectors.yaml is read by ConnectorFactory. In Layer C, the REST API, gRPC server and MCP server each resolve the tenant from a header or JWT, metadata, or the session, and call invoke.py. invoke.py first gets a tenant-pinned instance from ConnectorFactory, which resolves the config in the Layer A ConnectorConfigStore and injects SecretProvider, AuthProvider and PolicyHook, then calls BaseConnector.run in Layer A. run calls internal_execute on the Layer B connector class, which calls the external systems. Layer B also holds the per-connector package and the shipped connectors.
